title: A Remark on Hörmander Multipliers on Dunkl Hardy Spaces
summary: Let $\mathcal R$ be a normalized root system in $\mathbb R^N$ with a nonnegative multiplicity function $k$, and let $\mathcal F$ be the associated Dunkl transform. We prove a Hörmander multiplier theorem on the Hardy spaces $H^p_{\mathrm{Dunkl}}$, $0 0} \|ψ(\cdot)m(t\cdot)\|_{W_2^s} \mathbf N\left(\frac1p-\frac12\right), \] where $\mathbf N$ is the homogeneous dimension, then the Dunkl multiplier \[ \mathcal T_mf=\mathcal F^{-1}(m\mathcal Ff) \] extends to a bounded operator on $H^p_{\mathrm{Dunkl}}$.
